sections.title: 团队、委员会和理事会 / Teams, committees and councils

entries.en: The WCA's teams and committees are an integral part of the organization and perform the day-to-day tasks that are required to keep it functioning. These committees are made up of WCA community members, including WCA Delegates and competitors. Each team has a leader, whose role is to ensure the proper functioning of the team and guide other team members. When there are team or committee openings, information about how to apply is posted on the front page.
entries.zh: WCA的团队和委员会是组织不可分割的一部分，执行保持其运作所需的日常任务。这些委员会由WCA社区成员组成，包括WCA代表和参赛人员。每个团队都有一个领导者，其作用是确保团队的正常运作并指导其他团队成员。理事会是一种特殊类型的团队，为WCA董事会发挥咨询作用，由社区成员组成，而不是WCA工作人员。当有委员会、团队或理事会空缺时，有关如何申请的信息会发布在首页上。

entries.en: The contact details of this team/committee is not publicly available.
entries.zh: 这个团队/委员会的联系方式是非公开的。

entries.en: The WCA Archive Team (WAT) manages the development and maintenance of the WCA's historical archive. They document key speedcubing events and notable WCA milestones to be presented as part of a broader WCA timeline, to preserve the legacy of the WCA in speedcubing.
entries.zh: WCA档案组负责建设和维护WCA历史档案。该组会记录重要的速拧事件和WCA里程碑，并将其整理到WCA时间线中，以保留WCA在速拧领域的历史。

entries.en: The WCA Communication Team (WCT) oversees and supports communications of the WCA with the Community and the general public. The communication of the WCA should contribute to the Objectives of the WCA and support a general positive culture of friendliness, transparency, inclusiveness, openness, and responsiveness.
entries.zh: 该组负责世界魔方协会与魔方爱好者及社会公众之间的联系与沟通。沟通与推广工作有助于实现世界魔方协会的目标，并营造友好、透明、包容、开放且积极响应的魔方文化。

entries.en: The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) approves and announces WCA Competitions submitted by WCA Delegates, and ensure such announcements adhere to WCA quality standards. This team is also responsible for maintaining proper competition submission protocol from documents such as the WCA Competition Requirements Policy. The WCAT is NOT responsible for the organization and delegation of individual competitions.
entries.zh: 该组负责批准和宣布代表提交的WCA比赛，并确保此类公告符合WCA质量标准。该团队还负责维护比赛申请用的政策文件，如：《WCA赛事要求》。WCAT并不负责组织或监督各个比赛。

entries.en: The WCA Integrity Committee (WIC) performs independent investigations regarding WCA community members and incidents during WCA Competitions or on official, online WCA platforms. These incidents are alleged violations of the Values, Code of Conduct, Code of Ethics and/or Regulations of the WCA.
entries.zh: 该委员会负责对WCA社区成员以及WCA比赛期间或WCA官方在线平台上发生的事件进行独立调查。这些事件涉嫌违反WCA精神、行为准则、道德准则、规定。

entries.en: The WCA Executive Assistants Team (WEAT) carries out the administrative tasks of the WCA Board of Directors.
entries.zh: 该团队是负责执行处理WCA董事会的行政事务。

entries.en: The WCA Financial Committee (WFC) manages the overall finances of the WCA, including budgeting, reporting, analysis, bookkeeping, and tax filings. They also manage the WCA's largest source of income, the WCA Dues System, along with various funding programs that provide support to local communities at different stages of development, including Travel Funding, Equipment Funding, and Regional Organization Support.
entries.zh: 该委员会负责管理WCA的财务，包括预算编制、财务报告、财务分析、账单和报税。他们还管理WCA最大的收入来源，WCA会费系统，以及为处于不同发展阶段的当地社区提供支持的各种资助计划，包括交通资金、设备资金和对区域组织的支持。

entries.en: The WCA Marketing Team (WMT) manages the WCA Brand, seeking sponsorships, and marketing WCA Merchandise.
entries.zh: 该团队负责开发和管理WCA品牌、寻求赞助、支持WCA竞赛装备的分销以及营销WCA商品。

entries.en: The WCA Major Championship Team (WMCT) oversees the coordination and advancement of WCA Continental and World Championships by developing guidelines and strategic plans, managing host city selection, supporting organizing teams, and ensuring consistent championship experiences.
entries.zh: 该组负责监督WCA洲际和世界锦标赛的协调和推进，制定指导方针和战略计划，管理主办城市的选择，支持组织团队，并确保一致的锦标赛体验。

entries.en: The WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC) promotes continuous quality improvement within the WCA, as well as worldwide application of quality standards to ensure consistent high quality of processes, WCA Volunteers, Regional Organizations, Competition Organizers, and Competition Volunteers.
entries.zh: 该委员会负责支持和推动WCA的持续质量改进，并在全球范围内实施质量标准，确保WCA工作人员、区域组织、比赛组织者和工作人员遵循一致的高质量流程。

entries.en: The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) handles all issues which are related to the application, the improvement and the development of the WCA Regulations. They support WCA Delegates on any kind of procedural matters happening at competitions and decide on unresolved and uncovered incidents.
entries.zh: 该组负责与WCA规则的应用、改进和发展有关的所有问题。他们支持WCA代表处理比赛中发生的任何类型的程序性问题，并决定未解决和未发现的事件。

entries.en: The WCA Results Team (WRT) manages all data in the databases of the WCA, including competition results and persons data.
entries.zh: 该组负责管理WCA数据库中的所有数据，最重要的是比赛成绩和选手个人数据。

entries.en: The WCA Software Team (WST) manages the WCA's software (website, scramblers, workbooks, admin tools).
entries.zh: 该组负责管理WCA软件（官网、打乱程序、管理工具等）。

entries.en: The WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT) oversees and supports the recognition of the WCA as an international sports organization.
entries.zh: 该团队负责监督和协助WCA成为一个国际认可的体育组织。

entries.en: The WCA Appeals Committee (WAC) reviews and resolves appeals regarding decisions made by other WCA Volunteers. The WAC provides an independent and impartial review process to ensure that decisions are fair, reasonable, and in accordance with WCA policies and regulations.
entries.zh: 该委员会负责审查和解决针对其他WCA志愿者所做决定的申诉。WAC提供独立、公正的审查流程，以确保决定公平、合理且符合WCA政策和规定。

sections.title: 干事与董事会 / Officers and Board

entries.en: The officers of the WCA handle tasks relating to the non-profit status of the WCA. These officers are elected by the WCA Board. The Executive Director is the Chief Executive Officer of the WCA, the Chair presides over all Board meetings, the Secretary maintains the organization's documents, and the Treasurer manages financial matters of the WCA.
entries.zh: WCA董事负责处理与WCA非营利地位相关的任务。这些董事由WCA董事会选举产生。执行董事是WCA的首席执行官，主席主持所有董事会会议，秘书负责维护组织文件，财务主管管理WCA的财务事务。

entries.en: The WCA Board is responsible for leading the organization as a whole, and fulfilling any duties not fulfilled by other Teams and Committees
entries.zh: WCA董事会负责领导整个组织，并履行其他团队、委员会和理事会未履行的任何职责

sections.title: 关于 WCA / About the WCA

entries.en: Our Purpose is to empower the global speedcubing community and uphold a fun and fair competitive environment for all.
entries.zh: 我们的使命是：在公平、平等的条件下，在更多国家举办更多更有趣的比赛，并让更多人参与。

entries.en:
The World Cube Association governs competitions for mechanical puzzles that are operated by twisting groups of pieces, commonly known as 'twisty puzzles'. The most famous of these puzzles is the Rubik's Cube, invented by professor Rubik from Hungary. A selection of these puzzles are chosen as official events of the WCA.

As the WCA has evolved over the past decade, over 245,000 people have competed in our competitions. Despite this growth, we remain an organization that is almost entirely run by volunteers, from local organizers to WCA Delegates to even the WCA Board. We are very grateful to everyone who takes time out of their lives to allow the WCA to function. With more financial support, we hope to bring an even greater level of professionalism to our competitions as we continue to sanction more events across the globe.
entries.zh:
世界魔方协会负责管理转动式益智玩具（twisty puzzles）的比赛，这类玩具通常统称为“魔方”。其中最著名的是由匈牙利教授鲁比克发明的三阶魔方。WCA从这类魔方中选择了一部分作为官方比赛项目。

随着WCA在过去十年的发展，已有超过245,000人参加了我们的比赛。尽管有这样的增长，我们仍然是一个几乎完全由志愿者运营的组织，从当地组织者到WCA代表，甚至WCA董事会。我们非常感谢所有抽出时间为WCA做出贡献的人。有了更多的财政支持后，我们希望在认可全球各地比赛的同时，能够为我们的比赛提升到更高水平的层次。

entries.en: Our Values are Community, Fairness, Fun, Excellence, and Volunteerism.
entries.zh: 我们的精神是：来自世界各地的人们在友好的气氛中一起玩的开心，互相帮助，并表现出运动员的精神。

entries.en: The World Cube Association wants to bring opportunities for community membership and leadership to young people around the world through increasing the accessibility of our 'twisty puzzle' competitions. We believe that experiences at competitions and within our community create growth opportunities for the young people involved and that introducing puzzle events to new groups of people allows for our overall community to strengthen. A document containing the Board's Strategic Plan for the WCA can be found here.
entries.zh: 世界魔方协会希望通过增加魔方比赛，为世界各地的年轻人提供参与和领导社区的机会。我们相信，比赛和社区经历能够帮助年轻人成长，让更多人接触魔方，并推动魔方爱好者群体发展壮大。有关董事会对WCA愿景与战略的说明，可以在这里查阅。

entries.en: The World Cube Association has had over 245,000 unique competitors across 158 different regions and we are not planning on slowing down anytime soon! The cubing community has been growing steadily since our founding in 2004 and we want to encourage this to continue into the future by increasing the accessibility of competitions to new areas. In the future, we hope to support our community even more through collaborations and outreach to those who care about puzzles.
entries.zh: 世界魔方协会已有来自158个国家和地区的超过245,000名参赛者，而且我们近期并不打算放慢发展脚步！自2004年成立以来，魔方社区一直在稳步发展。我们希望在更多地区举办比赛，并通过推广以及与其他魔方爱好者合作，继续支持社区发展。

entries.en: Every two years, we sanction the competition that ultimately determines the world champion. These events require extremely careful planning by a number of volunteers, as well as a large financial commitment to reserve the venue and make necessary preparations.
entries.zh: 每两年，我们都会批准最终决定世界冠军的比赛。这些活动需要大量志愿者进行极其仔细的规划，并需要投入大量资金来预订场地并进行必要的准备。

entries.en: You can donate by credit card using Guidestar %{here_credit}, or by Paypal %{here_paypal}. If you prefer to write a check, you can write to:
entries.zh: 您可以使用信用卡在Guidestar %{here_credit}或PayPal %{here_paypal}平台捐款。如果您希望使用支票，请寄到：

entries.en: Donations are tax-deductible in the United States.

If you believe you would be able to contribute to the World Cube Association in a non-financial way, we would love to hear from you! Please get in touch with us at communication@worldcubeassociation.org.
entries.zh: 如果您希望为WCA提供帮助，我们会感到很高兴！欢迎发送邮件至communication@worldcubeassociation.org与我们联系。

entries.en: The World Cube Association is a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization. As a 100% volunteer-led nonprofit, we welcome your donations to help us further our vision of having more enjoyable competitions all over the world.
entries.zh: 世界魔方协会是一个 501(c)(3) 免税组织。 作为一个 100% 由志愿者主导的非营利组织，我们欢迎您的捐赠，以帮助我们进一步实现在世界各地举办更有趣的比赛的愿景。

entries.en: The WCA Board is responsible for leading the organization as a whole, and fulfilling any duties not fulfilled by other Teams and Committees
entries.zh: WCA董事会负责领导整个组织，并履行其他团队、委员会和理事会未履行的任何职责

entries.en: The day to day operations are run by the WCA's %{committees_and_teams}.

WCA Delegate is a role defined in the WCA Motions and depicted in the WCA Regulations. The primary duty of a Delegate is to oversee competitions on behalf of the WCA. A WCA Delegate is responsible for making sure that all WCA Competitions are run according to the Purpose, Values, and Regulations of the WCA. The WCA distinguishes between Senior Delegates, Regional Delegates, Full Delegates, Junior Delegates, and Trainee Delegates%{see_link}.

In addition to the duties of a WCA Delegate, a Senior Delegate or Regional Delegate is responsible for managing the WCA Delegates in their area and can also be contacted by the community for regional matters.

New Delegates are listed as Junior Delegates at first; afterwards they are requested to show proficiency managing WCA Competitions before being promoted to WCA Delegates.

Trainee Delegates are being trained for the position of WCA Delegate and can only oversee competitions in which a WCA Delegate is present.
entries.zh:
WCA 代表是《WCA 决议》中规定、并在《WCA 规则》中有所体现的职务。WCA 代表的主要职责是代表 WCA 监督比赛，确保所有 WCA 比赛均符合 WCA 的宗旨、价值观及规则。WCA 代表分为高级代表、区域代表、正式代表、初级代表和实习代表%{see_link}。

除履行 WCA 代表的基本职责外，高级代表和区域代表还负责管理其辖区内的 WCA 代表，并作为所在地区魔方社群处理地区事务的联系人。

新任代表最初担任初级代表，在证明其具备独立管理 WCA 比赛的能力后，方可晋升为正式代表。

实习代表正在接受成为 WCA 代表所需的培训，因此只能在有其他 WCA 代表在场的情况下监督比赛。

entries.en: All competitors automatically become members of the WCA in their first WCA competition.
entries.zh: 所有选手在参加完第一场WCA比赛之后自动成为WCA成员。

entries.zh: 找不到编号为“%{motion_id}”的动议。该动议可能已被撤销。

entries.zh: WCA承认以下成员作为官方比赛的代表：

No Regional Organizations are currently acknowledged by the WCA.
entries.zh: 目前没有区域组织被WCA认可。

entries.en: How to become an acknowledged WCA Regional Organization

The WCA recognizes various Regional Organizations worldwide. The purpose of a WCA Regional Organization is to organize WCA Competitions and support the WCA’s activities in the region. Regions wishing to form a Regional Organization are encouraged to contribute to the WCA in their area before submitting their application. For help organizing a WCA competition in your area, please contact your nearest WCA Delegate.
entries.zh: WCA认可世界各地的各种区域组织。WCA区域组织的目的是在相关地区组织WCA比赛并支持WCA在该地区的活动。鼓励希望组建区域组织的国家和地区在提交申请之前，为其所在地区的WCA做贡献。如需帮助组织您所在地区的WCA比赛，请联系您最近的代表。

entries.en: To actively organize or support WCA Competitions in the region of the organization
entries.zh: 成功在相关地区组织或协助过WCA比赛

entries.en: To contribute to the Continental WCA Competitions that are held in the continent of the Regional Organization, if required by the corresponding Organization Team
entries.zh: 在相关区域所在的大洲支持过洲际WCA比赛

entries.en: To respect and operationalize the Objectives set out in the WCA Bylaws and Motions
entries.zh: 尊重并推广WCA规则及附录中规定的宗旨

entries.en: To comply with all applicable WCA Regulations
To accept and comply with decisions of WCA Volunteers
entries.zh: 接受并遵守WCA志愿者的决定

entries.en: To keep on file at the WCA a copy of its current bylaws and, if applicable, regulations in an electronic format
entries.zh: 以电子格式向WCA提交其现行规则和附则的副本

entries.en: To apply for acknowledgment, please fill out this form.
entries.zh: 为获取认可，请填写这个表单。

entries.en: All the information below will only be visible to the WCA Board of Directors
entries.zh: 所有以下的消息都只有WCA董事会能看到
认可开始日期不能晚于认可结束日期

entries.en: Application successfully submitted! Please check your email, and wait for the WCA Board of Directors to review it
entries.zh: 申请已成功提交！请查收电子邮件，并等待WCA董事会审核

entries.zh: 您确定要删除这个区域组织请求吗？

sections.title: 常见问题 / Frequently asked questions

entries.en: If none of these answers helped, please %{contact_us}!
entries.zh: 如果这些问答一点帮助也没有，请%{contact_us}！

entries.en: You are already logged in with a WCA account.
You can claim your WCA ID %{here}.
entries.zh: 可以在%{here}认领你的 WCA ID。

entries.en: Create an account %{here}. After you log in with your new account, you will be asked to claim your WCA ID.
entries.zh: 在%{here}注册账号并登录以认领 WCA ID。

entries.en: How do I obtain a WCA ID and a WCA profile?
If you have never competed before, go to a competition! A WCA ID and WCA profile will be created for you when the results from your first competition are published.
entries.zh: 如果你从未参加过比赛，可以去参加一场比赛！成绩公布后，系统会自动为你创建 WCA ID。

entries.en: How can I find a WCA competition?
entries.zh: 如何找到 WCA 比赛？

entries.en: Check out our list of competitions
How can I register for a competition? Who can I refer to if I have problems registering for a competition?
entries.zh: 如何报名比赛？如果报名时有问题我应该联系谁？

entries.en: Many competitions do registration right here on the WCA website, but some use their own systems. You should contact the organizers of the competition you want to compete in for more details. %{comp_search_form}
entries.zh: 很多比赛使用 WCA 的报名系统，但也有使用他们自己系统的。你可以联系主办方咨询详细信息。%{comp_search_form}

entries.en: What are the requirements for attending a WCA competition? What do I need to know before attending a WCA competition?
entries.zh: 参加 WCA 比赛有什么要求？参加之前我需要知晓哪些？

entries.en: In general, there are not many requirements for a person to participate at a WCA competition. However, all participants of a competition are expected to have a good understanding of the WCA Regulations. If English is not your first language and you have trouble understanding the document, please read the Translations.
entries.zh: 通常来讲，参加 WCA 比赛并没有太多要求，所有选手都需要知悉 WCA 比赛规则。如果英语不是你的母语，无法理解该文档，请参阅 翻译。

entries.en: How can I have a WCA Competition in my hometown?
entries.zh: 我的家乡如何能有一场 WCA 比赛？

entries.en: If you are interested in organizing a competition, it's highly recommended to attend at least one or two competitions as a competitor to learn from the experience.
entries.zh: 如果你对组织比赛感兴趣，请先参加一两场比赛来学习经验。

entries.en: WCA Competitions must follow the WCA Regulations. The organization team doesn't have to know the regulations by heart, however, a deep knowledge of the basics of the regulations would definitely help in correctly organizing the competition.
entries.zh: WCA 比赛必须遵守 WCA 规则。主办团队可以不必牢记于心，但是对基础规则的深入了解有助于组织比赛。

entries.en: After that, the organization team must contact a nearby WCA Delegate. The supervision of a WCA Delegate is required in order to make a competition officially sanctioned by the WCA. The WCA Delegate will help guide the organization on how to host a successful competition.
entries.zh: 主办团队必须联系一个就近的 WCA 代表来监督以保证比赛是 WCA 官方认证的。WCA 代表会帮助主办团队尽力组织一场成功的比赛。

entries.en: Visit the WCA Competition Organizer Handbook for further information.
entries.zh: 请参阅 WCA 比赛主办指南获取更多信息。

entries.en: What are the WCA accounts for? What is the difference between WCA accounts and WCA profiles?
entries.zh: WCA 账号有什么用途？它和 WCA 个人资料有什么区别？

entries.en: You are assigned a WCA ID when the results from your first WCA sanctioned competition are published.
entries.zh: 当你的第一场比赛成绩公示时，你将会获得一个 WCA ID。

entries.en: WCA accounts allow you to prove to us who you are. This allows you to add a picture to your WCA profile, and allows you to register for competitions. This will protect you from other people pretending to be you.
entries.zh: WCA 账号可用于验证你的身份、向 WCA 个人主页上传照片以及报名参加比赛。这可以防止其他人冒充你。

entries.en: How do I change my profile picture?
entries.zh: 如何修改我的 WCA 主页照片？

entries.en: First, you need to create a WCA account and connect it to your WCA ID.
entries.zh: 首先，你需要注册一个 WCA 账号并认领你的 WCA ID。

entries.en: After you have connected your WCA account and your WCA ID, go to your edit profile page to change your profile picture.
entries.zh: 其次，点击这里编辑你的照片。

entries.en: How do I connect my WCA account with my WCA ID?
entries.zh: 如何关联我的 WCA ID？

entries.en: I am registered for a competition and want to sign up for an additional event, what should I do? Can I bring guests?
entries.zh: 我已经报名了一个比赛，但是先补报项目，应该怎么做？我可以携带陪同吗？

entries.en: Please contact the organizer. You can find the contact information on the competition website. If you are unsure where to find it, check the list of competitions.
entries.zh: 请联系主办方。你可以在比赛官网找到他们的联系方式。如果你不确定在哪，可以看看比赛列表。

entries.en: When are the results of a WCA competition uploaded to the WCA website?
entries.zh: WCA 比赛的成绩什么时候公示到 WCA 官网？

entries.en: After a competition has ended, the WCA Delegate has to double-check all score sheets and person data to eliminate possible errors. Once this is done, the results are sent to the WCA Results Team (WRT), which is responsible for uploading competition results and maintaining the WCA database. The WRT finally uploads the results to the WCA database as soon as possible.
entries.zh: 比赛结束后，WCA 代表将对成绩条和选手信息二次检查以尽量避免错误。然后他们会发送成绩到负责公示成绩和维护 WCA 数据库的 WCA 成绩组（WRT)。之后成绩组会尽快公示。

entries.en: Depending on the size of the competition and the Delegate's personal schedule, all this can take only a day or up to a week. Please be patient.
entries.zh: 公示时间取决于比赛规模和代表的个人日程，快则一天慢则一周。请耐心等待。

entries.en: Additionally, if you have connected your WCA account with your WCA ID (see below), you can enable email notifications about your results submission here.
entries.zh: 此外，如果你已经关联了 WCA ID（看下面），你可以在这里启用成绩公示的邮件通知。
我的魔方可以参加比赛吗？

entries.en: You can find the regulations regarding puzzles in Article 3. All puzzles have to be approved by a WCA Delegate. If you are unsure, please ask the Delegate of your competition. To be on the safe side, you should bring a replacement puzzle in case you are not allowed to use it.
entries.zh: 你可以在规则第三章里找到关于魔方的定义。所有魔方都需要经过 WCA 代表同意才能使用。如果你不确定，请在比赛时询问代表。以防万一可以多带一个魔方以便更换。

entries.en: May I use a magnetic puzzle in an official WCA competition?
entries.zh: 我可以在 WCA 官方比赛中使用磁力魔方吗？

entries.en: You are allowed to use magnetic puzzles as long as they comply with the WCA Regulations. Please pay particular attention to Regulation 3h.
entries.zh: 只要他们符合 WCA 规则你就可以使用。请特别注意 3h。

entries.en: I lost a center cap or a piece of my puzzle. Am I still allowed to use it?
entries.zh: 我丢了一个中心盖，这个魔方还能使用吗？

entries.en: You are not allowed to use this puzzle. Puzzles must not have any damages or other differences that significantly distinguish any piece from a similar piece (see Regulation 3j).
entries.zh: 该魔方不能使用。所有魔方上的块不能有任何损坏或者与其他块有明显差别（参考3j）。

entries.en: How old do I have to be to register for a WCA competition?
entries.zh: 几岁才能报名参加 WCA 比赛？

entries.en: There is no minimum age. However, you should ask your parents before registering (see Regulation 2b).
entries.zh: 没有限制。不过你需要征得你的监护人同意（参考2b）。

entries.en: The WQAC has published several documents for the community, you can download them below.
entries.zh: WCA质量保证委员会已为社区发布多份文件，您可以在下方下载。
给新手参赛者的裁判教学

entries.en: Before making an inquiry, you may wish to take a look at our Frequently Asked Questions! If you wish to contact a specific committee or team not listed here, you may check their details on this page.
entries.zh: 在询问前，也许您可以先看看我们的常见问题！如果您想要联系此处没有列出的特定委员会或团队，你可以试试在这个页面找到详细信息。

entries.en: Email sent - we'll get back to you soon.
entries.zh: 邮件已发送，我们会尽快回复您。

entries.en: To update your registration, you need to contact the organizers of the competition. We have prefilled the contact form with your requested changes - please submit the form.
entries.zh: 如要更新您的报名，您需要联系比赛的主办团队。我们已在联系表单中预先填写了您要求的更改，请提交表单。

entries.en: Who do you want to contact?
Contact organizers/delegates of a competition (to ask query regarding that particular competition, including results not yet published on the WCA website)
entries.zh: 联系比赛的主办团队/WCA代表(询问关于某场比赛的内容，包含还没有公布在WCA网站的成绩)

entries.en: Contact WCA for general queries (this can involve anything like WCA ID/profile, organizing competitions, competition rules, competition media, etc)
entries.zh: 关于WCA一般的询问（可以是WCA ID/个人信息，主办比赛，比赛要求规则，比赛时的媒体等等）

entries.en: Contact Results Team (for anything related to results or profile data on the WCA website)
entries.zh: 联系成绩组（关于比赛成绩和WCA网站上的个人信息的相关事务）

entries.en: Contact Software Team (to report issues with the WCA website or for software-related questions)
entries.zh: 联系软件组（报告网站或软件相关问题）

entries.en: Which of the following best describes your inquiry?
entries.zh: 以下哪一个最能形容您的提问内容？

entries.en: Edit my profile data (name, country, gender or DOB)
entries.zh: 修改我的个人信息（姓名、区域、性别或生日）
编辑其他人的个人信息

entries.en: Report an issue in a result
Please verify that you are not a robot.
Use this form if your birthdate stored in our database is different from the real one.
entries.zh: 如果记录在数据库的生日和你的真实生日不一致，请使用该表单。

entries.en: IMPORTANT: Attach a picture of a legal document (identity card, driver license, passport...) showing your name AND date of birth; feel free to blur-out/obfuscate any other personal data on the identification.
entries.zh: 重要：附加一张合法证件（身份证、驾驶证、护照等）的照片，确保你的名字和生日都在上面。

entries.en: Thank you for your message. We will contact you soon!
entries.zh: 感谢你的留言。我们将会尽快联系你！

sections.title: 魔方速拧历史 / Speedcubing history

entries.en: The WCA shares articles and images from competitions provided by the community on our media page. If you have something you would like to share, please fill out our general media submission form!
entries.zh: WCA 会在媒体页面与社区分享比赛中的精彩照片和文章。如果您有内容希望分享，请使用普通媒体提交表单！

entries.en: As you may have seen, the WCA has an active Instagram! To best reflect the global cubing community, we post content submitted to us by cubers from around the world.
entries.zh: 正如你可能已经看到的，WCA 有一个活跃的 Instagram! 为了更好地展现全球魔方社区，我们会发布世界各地魔方爱好者提交的内容。

entries.en: If you have high-quality photos or videos you would like us to post, please click the button below and fill out the form! In order us to post your content, you must own it and must give the WCA permission to post it. Due to the large number of submissions we receive, we can not post everything, but here are some tips to get your content posted:
entries.zh: 如果你有高质量的照片或视频希望我们发布，请点击下方按钮并填写表单。你必须拥有内容的全部使用权，并授权 WCA 进行发布。由于我们收到的投稿很多，无法发布所有内容。以下建议可以提高你的内容被采用的可能性。

entries.en: Make sure the photo/video quality is good. It doesn't have to be professionally shot but the quality shouldn't detract from the photo or video.
entries.zh: 确保照片/视频质量良好。它不一定是专业拍摄的，但质量不应该有损于照片或视频。

entries.en: Try to make your content interesting to a broad audience. Content that is only interesting for a few people does not belong here.
entries.zh: 尽量让内容对广泛的受众具有吸引力。只有少数人感兴趣的内容可能不适合在此发布。

entries.en: Post photos and videos that have to do with the WCA, as this is what our account is all about! We love to see cubers having fun!
entries.zh: 发布与 WCA 有关的照片和视频，这是我们账号发布的主要内容。我们喜欢看到魔友们享受其中！

entries.en: Sometimes, we will allow community members to host the official WCA Instagram story with a competition they are attending! If you're interested, please click the button and fill out the form below. The WCA Communication Team will reach out to you after all information has been submitted if you are approved for hosting. If you have any questions, please contact us.
entries.zh: 有时，我们会邀请参加比赛的社区成员主持WCA官方Instagram快拍！如果您有兴趣，请点击下方按钮并填写表单。表单信息填写完整并通过审核后，WCA传播组会联系您。如有任何问题，请联系我们。

entries.en: Our goal is to share a little personal side of every cuber and of every competition. This is not supposed to be a huge burden over the weekend and, of course, we want you to enjoy the competition first and then be able to share it.
entries.zh: 我们希望分享参赛者的个人故事和比赛内容。这不应成为您在比赛周末的负担，因此请先享受比赛，再进行分享。

entries.en: The role of a host can be summarized as follows:
entries.zh: 主持人的任务概括如下：

entries.en: Make a short introduction, talk about yourself and the competition
entries.zh: 做个简短介绍，分享您自己以及比赛

entries.en: Get some clips to get a feeling of the venue and the people, this could be just a shot from the competitor area and solving area
entries.zh: 拍摄一些能够展现赛场氛围和现场人群的短片，例如比赛区或参赛者等候区的画面

entries.en: Try to get some shots of people solving (fast people at their main events preferably)
entries.zh: 尝试拍摄正在比赛的参赛者（如果可以，优先拍摄在主项目中速度较快的参赛者）

entries.en: You could try to get mini interviews of people (organizers, delegates, etc...) saying what they are feeling about the competition
entries.zh: 您可以尝试拍摄简短采访，请主办方、代表等谈谈他们对比赛的感受

entries.en: You can also send pictures, it doesn't have to be only videos
entries.zh: 您也可以发送照片，不一定只能提交视频

entries.en: Our communications throughout the weekend typically go through a WhatsApp group. Please ensure that you are familiar with this messaging platform or let us know if you are not able to use it so that we can arrange other plans.
entries.zh: 我们在比赛周末通常使用WhatsApp群组沟通。请确认您熟悉该平台；如果无法使用，请告诉我们，以便安排其他沟通方式。

entries.en: Do you have other suggestions for Instagram or other social media content? Let us know!
entries.zh: 您对Instagram或其他社交媒体内容还有其他建议吗？请告诉我们！

entries.en: Developed and maintained by the WST
entries.zh: 由 WST 开发和维护

entries.en: This page is a non exhaustive list of tools which are known to be used to help with the organization of WCA competitions.
entries.zh: 本页是一份非详尽的工具清单，已知这些工具可用于帮助组织 WCA 的比赛。

entries.en: Not all tools on that page are maintained by the WST: it's definitely fine! We don't have the manpower to manage all the WCA-related software out there :)
entries.zh: 该页面上的所有工具并非都是由 WST 维护的，我们没有足够的人力来管理所有与 WCA 相关的软件 :)

entries.en: All the programs on this list have been used during real WCA competitions and integrate with the WCA website: they let you sign in with your WCA account to be able to import (and sometimes update) your upcoming competitions data. For each of them the maintainer(s) will be clearly written.
entries.zh: 列表中的所有程序都已在 WCA 比赛中实际使用，并与 WCA 网站集成。你可以使用 WCA 账号登录，以导入（并有时更新）即将举行的比赛数据。每个程序都会明确列出维护者。

entries.en: Managing competitors registrations can be done directly on the WCA website. Since managing groups and volunteers manually can be time-consuming, you may want to consider using one of the tools below.
entries.zh: 参赛者报名可以直接在 WCA 网站上管理。由于手动管理分组和工作人员可能很耗时，你可以考虑使用下方的工具。

entries.en: You will find here tools that let you manage the results of the competition while it's going on.
entries.zh: 你会在这里找到让你在比赛进行中管理比赛结果的工具。

entries.en: While results validation occurs right there on the website, you will have to use some tool to assign scrambles generated by TNoodle to the actual results submitted to the WCA website.
entries.zh: 尽管成绩验证会在网站上进行，你仍需借助一些工具加载 TNoodle 生成的打乱，并将最终成绩上传至 WCA 网站。

entries.en: Tool for generating and editing groups/task assignments for WCA competitions
entries.zh: 用于生成和编辑 WCA 比赛的小组/任务分配的工具

entries.en: Print certificates for WCA competitions using WCA Live
entries.zh: 使用 WCA Live 打印 WCA 比赛的证书

entries.en: Task and group management tool for WCA competition organizers. Among the main features you will find: sorting competitors by rankings, assigning tasks (judging, scrambling), deciding how many scrambles are needed, generating score sheets, personal sheets, and summaries... Check out the website to find out more.
entries.zh: 专为 WCA 赛事组织者设计的任务与分组管理工具。其主要功能包括：按排名对选手进行排序、分配任务（如裁判、打乱）、设定打乱次数、生成成绩表、选手个人表及汇总表等。欢迎访问网站了解更多详情。

entries.en: Print scorecards for WCA competitions using WCA Live
entries.zh: 使用 WCA Live 打印 WCA 比赛的记分卡

entries.en: TNoodle is the official scramble program which is used for WCA competitions. It is typically used by WCA Delegates prior to WCA competitions, but its user interface also allows anyone to generate any kind of scrambles for all WCA events.
entries.zh: TNoodle是用在WCA比赛的官方打乱程序。通常都是由WCA代表在比赛前使用，但它的界面也能够让任何人为所有的WCA比赛项目生成打乱。

entries.en: Platform for running WCA competitions and sharing live results with the world.
entries.zh: 用于举办 WCA 比赛并与世界分享实时结果的平台。

entries.en: Sometimes things happen... If you don't have network access, you will have to use the good old spreadsheet.
entries.zh: 有时难免会遇到网络问题。如果无法连接网络，就只能使用传统的电子表格。

entries.en: Can be used to assign scrambles generated by TNoodle to results. Import results from the WCA website (when using WCA Live), a spreadsheet, or a standalone WCIF file. Import scrambles from one or more TNoodle json file(s). Export results to the appropriate format for WCA submission.
entries.zh: 可用于将 TNoodle 生成的打乱分配给结果。从 WCA 网站（当使用 WCA Live 时）、电子表格或独立的 WCIF 文件导入结果。从一个或多个 TNoodle json 文件中导入打乱。将结果导出为适当的格式，用于提交 WCA。

entries.en: View competition groups of any ongoing competition
entries.zh: 查看所有进行中的比赛组

entries.en: The WCA logo was designed by Justin Eastman, in a design contest in January 2005. We liked the logo because of its design, the colours, and the fact that it does not specifically show a 3x3x3 cube.
entries.zh: WCA标志由Justin Eastman在2005年1月的设计比赛中提出。我们喜欢它的设计和颜色，也喜欢它没有特意展示三阶魔方的特点。

entries.en: Acceptable usage of the WCA logo is outlined in the WCA Logo Usage Policy. Please read this document before using the WCA logo in your own projects. Send any additional questions regarding WCA logo usage to the WCA Marketing Team.
entries.zh: WCA标志使用政策说明了WCA标志的正确使用方式。在自己的项目中使用WCA标志前，请仔细阅读该文件。如有其他疑问，请发送电子邮件联系WCA市场营销组。

entries.en: Below are additional style guidelines for correct usage of the WCA logo.
entries.zh: 下方是关于WCA标志正确用法的追加风格指南。

entries.en: The WCA logo exists in four color variations. The correct color variant should be used depending on the background color of the medium where the logo is placed.
entries.zh: WCA标志有四种颜色变化。正确的颜色变化应该根据该标志使用的媒体背景来正确使用。

entries.en: Use the primary variant whenever possible.
entries.zh: 尽可能使用这个主要的形式。

entries.en: Only use the mono variant when the primary variant is not suitable.
entries.zh: 只有在主要的形式不适合时才使用黑白形式。

entries.en: The WCA logo may be used without the logotype, following the same color guidelines above.
entries.zh: 遵循上面同样的颜色使用指南，WCA标志可以使用没有文字标志的版本。

entries.en: High resolution PNGs and vector versions of the WCA logo are available for download.
entries.zh: 此处可下载WCA标志的高分辨率PNG文件和矢量版本。

entries.en: I have read and accept the WCA Logo Usage Policy.
entries.zh: 我已阅读并接受WCA标志使用政策。

sections.title: 排行与纪录 / Rankings and records

entries.en: Unknown type parameter, must be either "single" or "average"
entries.zh: 未知类型参数，必须是 "单次 "或 "平均"

entries.en: Unknown show parameter, must be either "N persons", "N results", or "by region"
entries.zh: 未知显示参数，必须是 "N个人"、"N个结果 "或 "按地区"

entries.en: Please note that some filters (such as past years) are temporarily disabled. The Software Team is working to restore these filters - we are sorry for the inconvenience.
entries.zh: 请注意有些筛选功能（例如过去年份）已被暂时关闭。软件组正在想办法恢复这些筛选功能，造成不便敬请见谅。

sections.title: 选手与个人成绩 / Persons and personal results

entries.en: No person matches the given criteria.
entries.zh: 给定条件下无匹配选手。

entries.en: A missing rank or worse regional rank than the continent one is due to a change of region. Results from the previous region are not taken into account in the current region ranking.
entries.zh: 没有排名或者地区排名比洲际排名更差是由于国籍变更。前国籍的成绩并不会记录到当前地区排名。

entries.en: Are you sure you want to delete this media?
entries.zh: 你确定要删除该媒体资料吗？

entries.en: All media will be reviewed before being listed on the all media page.
entries.zh: 所有媒体资料在被列入所有媒体页面之前都将被审核。

entries.en: All media content must be related to the selected competition.
entries.zh: 所有媒体资料必须与所选比赛相关。

entries.en: All media content must be appropriate and clean and not contain any improper or offensive material.
entries.zh: 所有媒体内容必须合适，干净，不得含有任何不当或冒犯的材料。

entries.en: The media content must not have extensive presence of sponsors or ads.
entries.zh: 媒体内容不得存在大量赞助商或广告内容。

entries.en: All media content must have appropriate and descriptive titles.
entries.zh: 所有媒体内容必须有适当的描述性标题。
查看所有待定媒体资料
您可以在这里提交媒体资料。

entries.en: Are you sure you want to accept this media?
entries.zh: 你确定要接受这个媒体资料吗？

sections.title: 成绩与开发者导出 / Results and developer exports

entries.en: DEPRECATION NOTICE: Version %{old_version} of the Results Export has been deprecated, and support for it will be discontinued from %{deprecation_date}. Please switch to using Version %{new_version} before then.
entries.zh: 弃用通知：成绩导出版本 %{old_version} 已被弃用，并将于 %{deprecation_date} 起停止支持。请在此之前改用版本 %{new_version}。

entries.en: On this page we offer the WCA results for download in several formats so you can use/analyze them at large. We will usually update after each competition weekend when the results are finalized. The files are numbered and dated so you can see whether you have the newest version already.
entries.zh: 这里提供多种格式的 WCA 成绩下载，便于批量使用或分析。数据通常会在每个比赛周末的成绩确认后更新。文件带有版本号和日期，便于确认是否已获取最新版本。

entries.en: Note: Permalinks deliver the latest results export within a given version - ie, the v2 permalink will return the latest v2 export, but will stay on v2 even when v3 is released.
entries.zh: 注意：永久链接会提供指定版本中的最新成绩导出。例如，v2 永久链接会返回最新的 v2 导出，即使 v3 发布后也仍会停留在 v2。

entries.en: SQL statements, for import into SQL databases.
entries.zh: SQL 叙述句，用于导入SQL数据库用。

entries.en: Tab-separated values, for spreadsheets in OpenOffice.org, Excel, etc.
entries.zh: 制表符分隔值（Tab-separated values），可用于 OpenOffice、Excel 等电子表格程序。

entries.en: The included %{readme_filename} file contains the terms of use and a general description (in English, not translated):
entries.zh: 附上的 %{readme_filename} 文件含有使用条款和一般说明(英语版，无翻译)：
WCA软件组 开发人员导出

entries.en: On this page we offer the WST developer export for download as SQL dump. Details can be found at %{github_link}.
entries.zh: 在这个页面中，我们提供软件组用的SQL dump文件输出。细节可以在%{github_link}查看。
